changelog: Player: on-screen time — current / end for VOD and DVR; live shows position and local clock
TV Series: full-width season rail + episode list for Fire TV D-pad (larger panel, Back to close)
Player: faster channel zapping (debounced) and safer back navigation from playback
Branding: updated launcher, splash, and in-app icon styling (2.5.0 build)
Gist: replace apkUrl under flavors with your direct-download links (Dropbox ?dl=1 or raw) after upload
notes: Ship steps: (1) Upload the two signed APKs from app/build/outputs/apk/{firestick,premium}/release/ to Dropbox (or your Gist raw ota repo). (2) Replace every PASTE_YOUR_... apkUrl with a direct link (Dropbox: use ?dl=1 or &dl=1). (3) In GistPad, save this file as update.json in gist 6056e65b41641393abf585cecbd92d07 (or your manifest gist). (4) If you re-sign or rebuild, re-run: Get-FileHash .\app-firestick-release.apk -Algorithm SHA256 and update apkSize + sha256 per flavor.
